WOODWORK — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Occupational Information, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Occupational Information.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Occupational Information.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Occupational Information.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Occupational Information.

2. When learning Upholstery, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Upholstery.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Upholstery.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Upholstery.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Upholstery.

3. When learning Emergency Management, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emergency Management.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Emergency Management.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emergency Management.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emergency Management.

4. When learning Furniture Making, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Furniture Making.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Furniture Making.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Furniture Making.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Furniture Making.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

6. When learning Framed Wooden Doors and Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Framed Wooden Doors and Windows.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

8. When learning Estimation of Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Estimation of Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Estimation of Materials.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Estimation of Materials.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Estimation of Materials.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

10. When learning Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fittings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fittings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fittings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Fittings.

11. When learning Project Activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project Activity.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project Activity.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Project Activity.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project Activity.

12. When learning Entrepreneurship in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Entrepreneurship in Woodwork.

13. When learning Design in Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Design in Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Design in Woodwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Design in Woodwork.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Design in Woodwork.

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

15. When learning Blending wood with other materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Blending wood with other materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Blending wood with other materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending wood with other materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Blending wood with other materials.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Blending wood with other materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Furniture Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Framed Wooden Doors and Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Upholstery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Project Activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
